title: Publish current app version to production

requirements.text: Run the production preflight checks and build for the current app version, ensuring the frontend compiles and all static assets referenced by the UI exist at the correct absolute /assets/... paths (including the header logo).
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm typescript-check` completes with no TypeScript errors.
All referenced static assets load in the production build (no 404s for `/assets/...`, including `/assets/IMG-20260210-WA0045-4.jpg` and any `/assets/generated/...` paths used by the app).

requirements.text: Deploy the successfully built frontend to production on the Internet Computer and verify the deployed site renders correctly (header, sections, and footer) with the logo visible in the site header.
acceptanceCriteria: On the production URL, the site loads without a blank screen and without critical console errors.
The site header shows the brand text and the header logo image renders (not broken).

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose them as-is).
Do not edit immutable hook entrypoints: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor; add `backend/migration.mo` only if a state upgrade is required.
nonGoals: Adding new product features or changing marketing copy.
Redesigning the layout or theming beyond what is necessary to ensure a successful production build and deployment.
Implementing new backend logic (the backend can remain empty if not required for publishing).
